basis: Previously retained native CM01 response IDs and independent database snapshot, schema/source only; no new scenario or modelcall.

selection.idDefinition: Host-assigned complete selected semantic fact IDs; not model-declared citations. Does not describe recent conversation timeline or extra raw history fragments.
selection.nativeIdMapping: Strip exactly hindsight: from evidence_memory_ids; raw native memory_units.id unchanged.

inference.established: Final semantic selection included an observation sourced from the correction turn as well as one from the original turn. The correction turn was not entirely omitted.
inference.notEstablished: Whether the selected observation contains the required corrected detail; whether an omitted other fact or model application caused failure. Source-turn membership is not semantic equivalence.

independentMetadataReview.finding: Both original assessments lack record-ID-to-predicate mapping. Existing booleans do not establish retrieved_but_ignored.

secondarySourceFinding.scope: Observation original-source date can be lost when its own mentioned_at is absent even if source facts have a date.
secondarySourceFinding.action: Not changed speculatively. Pinned API schema/serializer supports mentioned_at and saved selected rows have it; actual raw recall payload was not retained.

decision: Keep original objective failure. Do not lower recall thresholds, increase context, change prompts or rebuild memory without the missing causal evidence. Continue other original available comparison entries; sealed candidate and owner M1 acceptance unchanged.
